info.title: Steward API
info.description:
Read-only access to the data Steward holds: processes and their versions, runs with their step journal and logs, decisions, schedules, webhook triggers, platform metadata, dashboard datasets, the audit log, users and teams, monitors (status, history, Zabbix low-level discovery), change requests and decision records, the service catalogue, the credentials register (documentation only, never secret values), database schema snapshots and their changes, and the data model itself as an Apache Ossie semantic model.

**Authentication.** Every endpoint except `/health` needs a personal API token: `Authorization: Bearer smt_…`. Create one on your profile page in the web UI (scope *read* is enough; tokens with scope *mcp* only work on the MCP endpoint). A token acts with the rights of its owner – use a dedicated service account with the *viewer* or *auditor* role for integrations. Session cookies are not accepted.

**Conventions.** JSON with camelCase fields; timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC; ids are strings. Lists return `{ items, nextCursor }` – pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` to get the next page (also offered as an RFC 8288 `Link: <…>; rel="next"` header). `limit` is 1–200 (default 50). Errors are problem details (RFC 9457, `application/problem+json`). Responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store` and `RateLimit-*` headers; above the limit the API answers 429 with `Retry-After`.

**Versioning.** The path carries the major version. Within v1 changes are additive (new endpoints, optional parameters and fields) – ignore fields you do not know. Breaking changes get a new major version; endpoints that are going away are announced with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers first.

get.description: Targets for the windows 1 h, 24 h, 7 d and 30 d of one source – a Gatus endpoint, a PromQL query or a Steward monitor – attached to a service or one of its applications, with the source's current uptime figures and the status per window: met, below target or no data. Archived objectives (and those of archived services) are left out unless `archived` says otherwise.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Archived objectives: left out (default), included, or only these

get.summary: Hourly samples of an availability objective
get.description: Newest first: the values Steward had read from Gatus at each hour, with the objective's status then (kept 90 days).

get.summary: List access change entries
get.description: Documented grants, revocations and changes of access rights (records of the type "Access change"), newest first. Includes entries created automatically by runs and entries documented after the fact. Only entries the token owner may read: administrators, auditors and approvers read all, others those of platforms they have a right on (and their own).

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Part of the subject id or name (case-insensitive)

200.description: A page of access change entries

schema.description: A page of access change entries

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

get.summary: List access reconciliation findings
get.description: Access changes the reconciliation found without a matching access change entry (open), documented after the fact (documented) or dismissed with a reason. Only findings of checks the token owner may read.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

get.summary: List control catalogues
get.description: Built-in (ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A, IEC 62443-2-1, NIS2 Art. 21(2) – identifiers and short topic names) and imported catalogues.

get.summary: List controls and the Steward items mapped to them

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

get.summary: Evidence coverage of controls in a period
get.description: Per control: covered (evidence in the period), gap (mapped items, but no evidence), unmapped, or notVisible (there is evidence, but none the caller may see), with the number of evidence items per kind and of those the caller may not see.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

get.summary: List corrective action findings
get.description: The register of corrective actions (ISO/IEC 27001 clause 10.2, Compliance module, preview): nonconformities and observations from audits and from events Steward noticed, with their source, severity, status, service, owner, due date, actions and affected controls – newest first. Only findings the token owner may read: administrators, auditors, designers and approvers all, others those they or their actions own and those of services they may edit.

parameters.name: supplierId
parameters.description: Only the findings about this supplier

parameters.name: overdue
parameters.description: true: only overdue findings, false: only those that are not

get.summary: Get a corrective action finding with its actions and effectiveness check
List statements of applicability
get.description: One statement of applicability (ISO/IEC 27001 clause 6.1.3 d, Compliance module, preview) per control catalogue: scope, counts of applicable, not applicable and undecided rows and of their implementation status, the latest approved version, a version waiting for approval and the rows changed since.

get.summary: Get a statement of applicability with its rows and versions
get.description: The current rows – applicable and why, implementation status, how it is met, the responsible party with the suggestion derived from the responsibility matrix of the services in scope, owner, last review, GRC reference, evidence links, the coverage of the last twelve months (as the token owner may see it) and open corrective action findings – and the versions with their SHA-256 and approval.

get.summary: Get the responsibility matrix of a service
get.description: Who does backup, recovery and continuity, patching and vulnerabilities, access management, logging and monitoring, and security incidents for the service: our team, a supplier (with its contract’s SLA and contractual RTO/RPO and its valid certificates, read from the supplier record), central IT or group, shared or not applicable – the recovery-test duty where the team does recovery itself, and the default controls of each area.

get.summary: List the sites of the plant registry
get.description: The sites (factories) of the enterprise the token owner may see, ordered by name, with counts of areas, buildings and assets. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get a site with its ISA-95 hierarchy and buildings
get.description: Areas with their work centers and work units (each with the building that applies: the innermost one), the buildings, contacts, external references, own fields and links. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: List assets
get.description: Assets of the sites the token owner may see, ordered by name, with their location (site, area, work center, work unit and the building that applies) and external references. Filter by site, node, domain, status, tag or an external reference (`ref=erp:10004711`). Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

parameters.name: node
parameters.description: Only assets in this area, work center or work unit (id)

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Only assets of this domain (their own, or their area’s)

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: An external reference: system:id, or only the id

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Only assets with this device profile (id)

parameters.name: dataPoint
parameters.description: With profile: only assets that deliver this data point of it

get.summary: Get an asset
get.description: An asset with its location, equipment (parent and children), taxonomy, lifecycle, capabilities, external references, own fields and links. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get what an asset delivers: its device profile, interfaces, KPI instances and checks
get.description: The asset's device profile and controller firmware, per interface whether it is set up and where (endpoint), data points that differ on this asset, where its data points are published, its KPI instances (job, parameters, dashboard or dataset), what Steward checks and the KPI definitions it can have. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: List device profiles
get.description: The device profiles of the installation (a catalogue: controllers and devices with their interfaces and data points), ordered by name. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get a device profile with its interfaces and data points
get.description: Interfaces (protocol, direction, port, authentication, the client they need) with their data point groups and data points (data type, UCUM unit, address, access, update rate), file sets, the assets with this profile and the KPI definitions that read it. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: List KPI definitions
get.description: The KPI definitions of the installation (a catalogue), ordered by name, with their category, unit, ISO 22400-2 trend and counts. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get a KPI definition
get.description: Inputs, parameters (type, default, aliases, range), result columns (sum, ratio, ignore), the computation and its limits, the ISO 22400-2 attributes, its problems, the assets with an instance and those that could have one. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get the OT network of a site
get.description: The IEEE 802.1Q VLANs of a site (subnets, ranges, the linked Steward network segment and a hint when they differ), its IEC 62443-3-2 zones (criticality, VLANs, SL-T) and conduits (two zones, direction, protocols, controls, the records that link to them), the devices and data paths of its assets (collector, transfers, destinations, the next and previous link of a chain), every asset's live status (online, offline, unknown – only from linked checks) and the systems the data paths name. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get the devices, data paths and live status of an asset
get.description: The asset's devices (host name, MAC as EUI-48, VLAN, address, switch port, state, flags, linked checks and live status), its data paths and the checks linked to the asset itself. The live status is online, offline or unknown, only from the linked checks (monitors, dataset freshness); a monitor or dataset the token owner may not see is not named. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get the data collections of an asset
get.description: What collectors (gateways, ETL jobs) read from the asset: per collection its collector, mode, interval, triggers, destination, access patterns and items – the address read, the collector's name for it and the data point it is mapped to (or none) – with the coverage (mapped, raw, data points no collection reads). Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get whether an asset’s documentation is confirmed as still current
get.description: 0.14: the last “Still current” of the asset’s documentation as a whole and of each of its documents (records linked to the asset, and those it inherits from its profile, collections and sinks), who confirmed it when, and whether a confirmation is due by the review interval of the document type or the site – a hint, never an error. Read-only. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get the Insights Hub mapping of a sink and its last check
get.description: 0.14: per item of the collection the Insights Hub asset, aspect and variable it goes to (its own, or the sink's default), the result of the last check of the mapping against the tenant (the asset, aspect and variable exist; a unit or type that differs from the data point's is a hint), the monitor checks that watch it (a monitor the token owner may not see is counted, not named), and the counts: mapped, verified, watched. The asset hierarchy in Insights Hub is not compared with the plant's. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: List the problems Steward finds in the plant data
get.description: What Plant → Checks shows: KPI instances whose inputs the asset does not deliver, parameters outside their definition, references to profiles, interfaces or data points that do not exist, ratios without their denominator … First the problems of the assets the token owner may see (by asset name), then those of the KPI definitions (by name). Filter by site, asset, KPI definition (its own problems and those of its instances) or kind. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: Only problems of assets of this site (id)

parameters.name: kpi
parameters.description: Only problems of this KPI definition and of its KPI instances (id)

get.summary: Export the plant registry in the import format
get.description: The registry as a document of format 1 (docs/PLANT.md, JSON Schema docs/plant/plant-registry-1.schema.json), the same as Plant → Import → Export: every site the token owner may see with the device profiles, KPI definitions, the assignments of their assets and the OT network (`ot_networks`, `asset_networks`); one site (`site`, with the assignments and OT network of its assets); the catalogues only (`part=catalogue`); one device profile (`profile`) or one KPI definition (`kpi`). Sites the token owner may not see and their assets are never in it; the catalogues belong to the installation. YAML by default, JSON with `format=json`; both import back unchanged. Recorded in the audit log with the token. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: One site (`site:`) with the assignments of its assets

parameters.name: part
parameters.description: `catalogue`: the device profiles and KPI definitions only

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: yaml (default) or json: the same document

get.summary: List the security advisories affecting the plant’s sites
get.description: CSAF 2.0 advisories matched to assets by manufacturer, model and firmware – by default only those with a match at a site the token owner may see (`all=true`: every advisory), filtered, sorted (`sort`: severity – the default –, updated, published, affected, title; `order`) and paged by the server. Counts and status are for those sites (with `site`: for that site). Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Only advisories naming this vendor (compared normalised: letters and digits, legal forms left out)

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Also advisories that match no asset of the token owner’s sites

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: severity (default, with CVSS), updated, published, affected (assets), title

get.summary: Get a security advisory with the assets it affects
get.description: Its vulnerabilities and remediations, and its matches at the token owner's sites: exact and possible, with the reasons, the decisions, the fixed firmware and the remediation per asset. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get the security advisories of an asset
get.description: Every advisory that matches the asset – exact, possible and dismissed – with the match and its remediation. Only while the plant registry module is on (Settings → Modules); otherwise 404.

get.summary: Get a schema snapshot of a database platform

get.summary: Export a schema snapshot of a database platform

get.summary: List the costs of services, applications, teams or platforms
get.description: One row per scope and currency (no conversion between currencies) with the current month so far, the last month, the forecast of the current month and the budget. Showback from AWS, Snowflake, Confluent Cloud, AI gateways and FOCUS files (docs/COSTS.md).

get.summary: Get the costs of a service, application, team or platform
get.description: The last 12 complete months and the current month so far per currency (EffectiveCost and BilledCost, FOCUS), the forecast, the trend, the costs by provider and service, the applications or platforms behind them, what no application is linked to (platforms), the sources and the monthly budget.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The id of the service, application, team or platform

get.summary: Get the cost plan of a service for a fiscal year
get.description: Service cost planning (docs/COSTS.md#planning-per-service): the plan lines and cost entries of a fiscal year (one start month for the whole instance), per line and currency planned, planned to date, incurred to date, expected and the difference, the months, the cloud and platform costs read for the service (only when the token owner sees every application of it), unplanned entries and renewals in the next 90 days. Not paged: a service has at most 200 plan lines and 2,000 cost entries per fiscal year, so the answer is bounded.

parameters.name: fiscalYear
parameters.description: The fiscal year (the calendar year it starts in); default: the current one

get.summary: List the commitments of payment schedules
get.description: What the payment schedules of supplier contracts still owe (docs/COSTS.md#commitments): per schedule of a service the token owner may see, the scheduled payments dated today or later – to contract end and to the earliest exit, per fiscal year (the current one and the next four) and later – the next payment, the notice-by date and the notice warning. Scheduled payments, not liabilities: entries are not subtracted; amounts per currency, never converted, null where the token owner may not see the paying service's amounts. Notice warnings first.
